article.story: NASHVILLE, Tenn. -- — Sawyer Dotson had 14 points in Lipscomb’s 92-67 victory over Milligan on Sunday. Dotson also added nine rebounds for the Bisons (4-4). Luke Jack scored 13 points while going 4 of 10 from the floor, including 1 for 3 from 3-point range, and 4 for 7 from the line. Hendrix Loughridge finished 5 of 7 from the field to finish with 11 points, while adding seven rebounds. William Robinson, Judah Carlyle and Ahmari Hicks also scored eight points for the Buffs. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
